# T-3: Persist selected official preset state

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Save enough plugin state for selected non-base official presets while keeping base-only setup minimal.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Selecting a non-base official preset writes plugin source/package state needed for later resolution.
- Selecting only `base` avoids unnecessary official plugin package state.
- Generated config type can be resolved and validated in the generated project root.
- Public config writes do not copy local-only plugin sources or packages from `config.local.json`.

## Implementation Notes
Perform persistence before `validatePresetChain()` runs against the generated config. Preserve existing wizard-managed config merge behavior. Avoid writing a merged raw config object that includes `config.local.json` overlay entries; either use a public-config-only mutation helper or adjust the official package helper accordingly.

## Test Strategy
Test generated config and plugin state for official non-base and base-only selections. Test `resolveMultiChains()` and `validatePresetChain()` against the generated project root.
